stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: 49er Faith-Fool just moved above the projected league median.
🚨 RULED OUT: C. Tate won't play, and he's in Ruffing the Passer's starting lineup. Kickoff's Sunday 1 PM. Clock's ticking.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs Ruffing the Passer. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 83% / 58%, Ruffing the Passer 66% / 35%.
😬 Claremont In Yo Stace! would be leading Ruffing the Passer if they'd started Cam Skattebo over Devin Singletary — instead they trail by 13.90 pts.
⚡ Early edge: Gibb it to Me Baby went from 63% to 95.2% against Mr. Action Jackson, led by Likely (28.70 pts).
🔮 Kyle Tucker vs Kirbo Crushers is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 19.31 pts.
🎲 GUTSY CALL: Claremont In Yo Stace! started Singletary (NYG's RB2) over Skattebo. It backfired: Skattebo outscored Singletary by 26.90.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 72% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 32% with none (now 57%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ TEN: JAX −2.5 at open, JAX −10.5 now. News: "Rookie WR Carnell Tate among multiple Titans starters ruled out vs. Jaguars"
💥 BYE-MAGEDDON: Kyle Tucker has 3 starters on bye this week (Irving, Williams and Broncos D/ST). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🧾 The waiver dust has settled: 6 claims went through. Top prize: Corey Kiner (RB, proj 10.34 pts) to TDsMaGee.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Gibb it to Me Baby added Jake Bates (K, projected 9.32 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 13% against Mr. Action Jackson — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted Mr. Action Jackson after the favorite flipped 8 times.
